answer: Each agent must stake a bond and solve a unique proof-of-work kernel tied to its identity, making every fake account cost real compute and capital. A new agent then makes a supervised voyage through a probation epoch, where peers on the knoll of consensus observe its behavior; only after consistent honest work is the bond unlocked. Creating thousands of sybils means paying that stake and work thousands of times, which is economically irrational. Operator sa0005 applies this at Qzw3Qz2BzJ.
